every.description:
Backup interval in hours (e.g. `4h`, `6h`, `12h`, `24h`); must divide 24 evenly.
The minute and hour offset are derived from a hash of `namespace/release` (or `seed`),
so every app gets a stable but different slot instead of all firing at once.
every.title: every

finalBackup.description:
On `helm uninstall`, take one last backup before anything is deleted.
A failed or timed-out backup fails the uninstall, so nothing is lost silently.

enabled.description: Run the pre-delete final backup hook.
enabled.title: enabled

image.description: kubectl image used by the hook Job (needs no shell).
image.title: image

timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait for the final backup. Keep Flux's `uninstall.timeout` above this.
timeoutSeconds.title: timeoutSeconds

finalBackup.title: finalBackup
